children.innerHTML: Align is a physiotherapy clinic for people who want a plan, not a punch card. Real assessment, honest timelines, and rehab built around the life you're trying to get back to.
Assessments from $85 · most insurers billed directly · no referral needed
Eight weeks from 'can't tie my shoes' to a 10k. They never once called it a miracle; they called it Tuesday.
Desk backs, deadlift backs, 'I just sneezed' backs. All welcome, all fixable-ish.
Runners, stairs-avoiders and the recently resurfaced. Load is medicine, dosed right.
Frozen, clicky, or simply furious from a laptop. We speak all three.
From sprain to start line with a plan and a date, not vibes and a foam roller.
Knees, hips, shoulders after the hardware. We work from your surgeon's protocol.
Book the assessment anyway. Diagnosing the vague ache is the fun part. For us, anyway.
The arc, in four honest stages
An hour of questions, movement tests and straight talk. You leave knowing what it is, what it isn't, and roughly how long.
Settle the angry tissue first. Hands-on where it helps, load management where it matters, reassurance throughout.
Progressive strength work in the gym, not just on the bench. This is the part that sticks, and the part most clinics skip.
Back to the sport, the garden or the grandkids, plus a maintenance plan so we become a memory, not a subscription.
Our average episode of care is six sessions, not sixteen. You get homework that fits in fifteen minutes, a plan with an end date, and discharge the moment you don't need us.
Fifteen years of backs, from powerlifters to postal workers. Believes almost everything is trainable and says so.
The surgeon-whisperer. Runs rehab exactly to protocol, then slightly past what you thought possible.
Explains pain so clearly patients get better mid-sentence. Also the clinic's strongest overhead press. It isn't close.
One hour with a clinician beats forty tabs. Next-day assessments most weekdays.
